title: Cancel Spotify Premium in India: Steps, Refunds, UPI (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel Spotify Premium in India from your account page, see what happens to Premium and your playlists, check refund rules, and stop a UPI AutoPay mandate.
h1: How do you cancel Spotify Premium in India?
summary: To cancel Spotify Premium in India, open your account page in a browser, select Cancel plan under Your plan or under Manage your plan, and go through the confirmation message. Premium stays active until your next billing date, then the account switches to free and your playlists and saved music stay with you. If a partner such as a mobile or internet provider manages your payments, cancel with that partner, and if you pay through a UPI app, also revoke the AutoPay mandate there.
stepsHeading: How to cancel Spotify Premium in India

steps.name: Open your account page
steps.text: Go to spotify.com in a browser on any device and log in with the method you used to sign up, such as email, phone number, Apple, Google or Facebook. Then open your account page. Spotify's help article describes cancelling there, so use a browser if the app menu does not match.

steps.name: Select Cancel plan
steps.text: Select Cancel plan under Your plan at the top of the screen, or under Manage your plan. If you are the manager of a Duo or Family plan, this cancels the whole plan. If you are only a member, it removes your account from the plan without cancelling it.

steps.name: Finish the confirmation
steps.text: Continue through to the confirmation message. Premium stays active until your next billing date, then the account switches to free. Take a screenshot of the confirmation, because the help article does not describe a separate cancellation email.

steps.name: Check for a partner-billed plan
steps.text: If there is no Cancel plan option, your plan is probably billed by a partner company. Go to Manage your plan, check Payment, and use the contact link shown there.

steps.name: Revoke the UPI mandate
steps.text: Open the AutoPay section of your UPI app and revoke any Spotify mandate with your UPI PIN. In Google Pay it sits under Autopay, in the Live tab. The label may read AutoPay or Mandates depending on your app version.

sections.heading: What happens to your plan after you cancel
paragraphs: Spotify's billing help says each Premium plan is charged once per month. Cancelling stops the next monthly charge. It does not reverse one already taken, and Spotify's refund page says you keep what you paid for and stay on Premium until the end of the billing period.

Cancelling during a zero-priced free trial switches the account to free straight away. Zero-priced trials and legacy Premium plans cannot be reactivated once cancelled, so returning later means signing up on the current plan list.

sections.heading: Refunds and plans bought through a partner
paragraphs: Spotify's refund page says that if you no longer want Premium, you can cancel any time and keep what you paid for. It does not promise a refund for unused days in the current month, so if you want money back for a specific charge, contact Spotify support with the transaction reference from your receipt. Gift cards bought from a store cannot be refunded by Spotify.
Payments made through a partner are refunded by that partner, whose details appear under Your plan on your account page. For a Google Play charge, use the Play Store refund request option instead.

sections.heading: Canceled but still charged
paragraphs: The most common cause is being logged in to a different Spotify account from the one you cancelled. Check the account page you are on before trying again. Spotify's help says that if you cancelled just after a payment went through, you will not be charged again and can keep Premium until the account switches to free.

A second charge in one month can happen when a failed payment is retried. Your bank statement may show both the failed attempt and the successful one, and a pending entry is usually a temporary authorisation from your payment provider.

sections.heading: Stopping the UPI AutoPay mandate
paragraphs: Spotify's UPI help page says you can pay through a UPI app, by UPI ID or by QR code on desktop, and that your UPI provider must support recurring payments through UPI AutoPay. It does not say how each renewal is collected, so after you cancel, check the AutoPay or Mandates list in every UPI app you have used with Spotify.

In Google Pay, Google's help says you can change or revoke a mandate from the Live tab under Autopay, with your UPI PIN. A revoked mandate cannot be debited under that mandate again. Google Pay also notifies you 24 hours before a bank debit, and you can pause or cancel from that notification. Cancel the Spotify plan first, then revoke the mandate, so no payment is left waiting to fail.

sections.heading: Why tracking renewals helps
paragraphs: Spotify renews monthly, so a Premium plan you have stopped using can run for months unnoticed. Writing it down with its renewal date and monthly cost makes the next debit visible before it happens. Essara works this way: you add each subscription or UPI mandate yourself, set its renewal date and see the monthly and yearly cost in one place. It does not connect to your bank, UPI app or SMS, so every entry is typed in by you.

faqs.q: Can I cancel Spotify Premium from the Android app?
faqs.a: Spotify's help article describes the cancel option on the account page and does not name an in-app menu. The safest route is to open spotify.com in a browser, log in and cancel there.

faqs.q: Will I get a refund if I cancel Spotify Premium mid-month?
faqs.a: Spotify says you can cancel any time and keep what you paid for, with Premium running until the end of the billing period. Its refund page does not promise money back for unused days, so contact Spotify support if you want a refund for a specific charge.

faqs.q: Does Spotify offer a prepaid Premium plan in India?
faqs.a: I could not confirm one in Spotify's official help pages, which describe monthly charges. Check the plan options at checkout, and if a plan is prepaid, the payment screen should say so before you pay.

faqs.q: Spotify still debited my UPI account after I cancelled. What now?
faqs.a: Open the AutoPay or Mandates section of your UPI app and revoke the Spotify mandate with your UPI PIN. Then contact Spotify support with the transaction reference, the charge date and a screenshot of the cancellation confirmation.

faqs.q: Why is there no cancel option on my Spotify account?
faqs.a: Spotify's help gives three common reasons. The account may be on free, so there is no Premium plan to cancel. The plan may be billed by a partner, so you cancel with that partner. Or you may be a member of a Duo or Family plan, where only the plan manager can cancel the whole plan.
